findings.description: Argument.get_help_record returns (metavar, self.help) without substituting an empty string, so an undocumented argument yields a None description, contrary to the docstring's promise of an empty description.
findings.rationale: Trigger: a command with one argument that has help and another argument with no help. format_options sees an argument with help, so it calls write_dl on records that include (metavar, None) for the undocumented argument. The formatter then wraps the None description via text wrapping, which raises a TypeError. Impact: help output for such a command crashes instead of listing the argument with an empty description.
